description: Convert data between CSV, JSON, YAML and XML (content ≤1MiB, result returned as text); the source format is auto-detected when from is omitted — set from explicitly to override a wrong guess. Conventions: CSV first row = header → array of objects, all cell values stay strings; XML attributes become @attr keys, mixed text becomes #text, repeated tags become arrays; XML output wraps a non-single-key root in <root> and top-level array items as <item>

from.description: Source format, optional — auto-detected when omitted

name: convert_data
